title: Guilt, envy and stress
focus: 焦虑 · 委屈 · 内疚 · 羡慕 · 遗憾 · 崩溃 · 发泄 · 松了一口气
body:
# Guilt, envy and stress

Words for the feelings that are hard to name in a second language: guilt, envy, feeling wronged, falling apart and relief. They come up with friends, partners and parents.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 焦虑 | jiāolǜ | anxious (ongoing worry) | scorching worry that keeps burning |
| 委屈 | wěiqu | to feel wronged / hurt by unfair treatment | bent down, made to yield |
| 内疚 | nèijiù | to feel guilty (about something you did) | a lingering ache inside |
| 羡慕 | xiànmù | to envy (in a harmless, admiring way) | covet + admire → friendly envy |
| 遗憾 | yíhàn | a pity / regrettable (out of your control) | left undone, heart still feels it |
| 崩溃 | bēngkuì | to break down / fall apart (emotionally) | landslide plus dam burst |
| 发泄 | fāxiè | to vent / take out (anger, stress) | let it flow out → vent |
| 松了一口气 | sōngle yì kǒu qì | to breathe a sigh of relief | loosened the breath you held |

## Which word?

**遗憾 vs 后悔 (L7)**: 后悔 is regretting something you did; 遗憾 is a pity about something out of your control.

**内疚 vs 后悔**: 内疚 is guilt toward someone you let down; 后悔 is wishing you'd chosen differently.

## Sentences

- 截止日期快到了，我焦虑得天天失眠。 jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, wǒ jiāolǜ de tiāntiān shīmián: The deadline's coming up and I'm so anxious I can't sleep.
- 手术很成功，全家都松了一口气。 shǒushù hěn chénggōng, quán jiā dōu sōngle yì kǒu qì: The surgery went well, and the whole family breathed a sigh of relief.
- 别把情绪发泄在孩子身上。 bié bǎ qíngxù fāxiè zài háizi shēnshang: Don't take your mood out on the kids.
- 被领导当众批评，她委屈得哭了。 bèi lǐngdǎo dāngzhòng pīpíng, tā wěiqu de kū le: The boss criticized her in front of everyone, and she felt so wronged she cried.
- 昨天把压力发泄在我妈身上，现在挺内疚的。 zuótiān bǎ yālì fāxiè zài wǒ mā shēnshang, xiànzài tǐng nèijiù de: Yesterday I took my stress out on my mum, and now I feel pretty guilty.
- 我挺羡慕外向的人，跟谁都聊得来。 wǒ tǐng xiànmù wàixiàng de rén, gēn shéi dōu liáo de lái: I really envy outgoing people who can chat with anyone.
- 活动取消了，虽然遗憾，可我也松了一口气。 huódòng qǔxiāo le, suīrán yíhàn, kě wǒ yě sōngle yì kǒu qì: The event got cancelled. It's a pity, but I'm also relieved.
- 话说回来，崩溃也没用，还得接着干。 huà shuō huílai, bēngkuì yě méi yòng, hái děi jiēzhe gàn: That said, falling apart won't help. You still have to keep going.

cards.Example: 最近工作压力大，我有点焦虑。 zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, wǒ yǒudiǎn jiāolǜ: Work's been stressful lately and I'm a bit anxious
cards.Notes: 焦 jiāo scorched, 灬 fire (烤焦, 焦急) + 虑 lǜ worry, think over (考虑, 顾虑) = scorching worry that keeps burning. 焦虑 = lingering anxiety (also the clinical word); 着急 = worried and impatient about something urgent; 紧张 = nervous in the moment

cards.English: to feel wronged / hurt by unfair treatment
cards.Example: 明明不是她的错，她觉得特别委屈。 míngmíng bú shì tā de cuò, tā juéde tèbié wěiqu: It clearly wasn't her fault, so she felt really wronged
cards.Notes: 委 wěi bend, yield (委婉) + 屈 qū bend, be wronged (屈服, 冤屈) = bent down and made to yield, so you swallow unfair treatment. 屈 goes neutral-tone here. 受委屈 = to be treated unfairly; 别委屈自己 = don't sell yourself short

cards.English: to feel guilty (about something you did)
cards.Example: 没去机场接他，我挺内疚的。 méi qù jīchǎng jiē tā, wǒ tǐng nèijiù de: I feel pretty guilty I didn't pick him up at the airport
cards.Notes: 内 nèi inside (内部, 内向) + 疚 jiù remorse, 疒 sickness + 久 long (also its sound) = a lingering ache inside. Moral guilt only; legally guilty is 有罪. 惭愧 = ashamed of falling short

cards.English: to envy (in a harmless, admiring way)
cards.Example: 真羡慕你，每天都不用加班。 zhēn xiànmù nǐ, měitiān dōu búyòng jiābān: I really envy you, never having to work overtime
cards.Notes: 羡 xiàn covet: 羊 sheep over a drooling mouth, craving something tasty + 慕 mù admire, long for, 㣺 heart (爱慕) = wanting what someone has while admiring them. Friendly and positive, unlike 嫉妒

cards.English: a pity / regrettable (out of your control)
cards.Example: 你没能来，真是太遗憾了。 nǐ méi néng lái, zhēn shì tài yíhàn le: It's such a shame you couldn't make it
cards.Notes: 遗 yí leave behind (遗产, 遗传) + 憾 hàn regret, 忄 heart + 感 feel = something left undone that the heart still feels. Politer and more formal than 可惜; 很遗憾地通知您 = we regret to inform you

cards.Example: 电脑死机了，文件全没了，我快崩溃了。 diànnǎo sǐjī le, wénjiàn quán méi le, wǒ kuài bēngkuì le: My computer crashed and all my files are gone, I'm about to lose it
cards.Notes: 崩 bēng collapse, 山 mountain (雪崩 avalanche) + 溃 kuì burst, 氵 water (a dam giving way) = landslide plus dam burst, total collapse. Often used as casual exaggeration; also for systems and economies collapsing

cards.Example: 你别把气发泄在我身上。 nǐ bié bǎ qì fāxiè zài wǒ shēnshang: Don't take it out on me
cards.Notes: 发 fā send out (发出, 发脾气) + 泄 xiè leak, let out, 氵 water (泄露, 泄气) = let it flow out. Pattern: 把……发泄在……身上 = take it out on someone

cards.English: to breathe a sigh of relief
cards.Example: 听说他没事，我终于松了一口气。 tīngshuō tā méi shì, wǒ zhōngyú sōngle yì kǒu qì: Hearing he was okay, I finally breathed a sigh of relief
cards.Notes: 松 sōng loosen (放松, 松开) + 一口气 one breath = loosened the breath you were holding. Opposite feeling: 紧张, where 紧 = tight

cards.English: The deadline's coming up and I'm so anxious I can't sleep.
cards.Hanzi: 截止日期快到了，我焦虑得天天失眠。
cards.Pinyin: jiézhǐ rìqī kuài dào le, wǒ jiāolǜ de tiāntiān shīmián.
cards.Notes: 焦虑 (L15) + 截止日期 (L6) + 失眠 (L13). 焦虑 = lingering worry; 紧张 = nervous in the moment.

cards.English: The surgery went well, and the whole family breathed a sigh of relief.
cards.Hanzi: 手术很成功，全家都松了一口气。
cards.Pinyin: shǒushù hěn chénggōng, quán jiā dōu sōngle yì kǒu qì.
cards.Notes: 松了一口气 (L15) + 手术 (L13). 一 before 口 (3rd tone) is yì.

cards.English: Don't take your mood out on the kids.
cards.Hanzi: 别把情绪发泄在孩子身上。
cards.Pinyin: bié bǎ qíngxù fāxiè zài háizi shēnshang.
cards.Notes: 发泄 (L15) + 情绪 (L7). Pattern: 把……发泄在……身上 = take it out on someone.

cards.English: The boss criticized her in front of everyone, and she felt so wronged she cried.
cards.Hanzi: 被领导当众批评，她委屈得哭了。
cards.Pinyin: bèi lǐngdǎo dāngzhòng pīpíng, tā wěiqu de kū le.
cards.Notes: 委屈 (L15) + 领导 (L6). 屈 is neutral tone here: wěiqu.

cards.English: Yesterday I took my stress out on my mum, and now I feel pretty guilty.
cards.Hanzi: 昨天把压力发泄在我妈身上，现在挺内疚的。
cards.Pinyin: zuótiān bǎ yālì fāxiè zài wǒ mā shēnshang, xiànzài tǐng nèijiù de.
cards.Notes: 发泄 (L15) + 内疚 (L15) + 压力 (L4). 内疚 is moral guilt only; legally guilty is 有罪.

cards.English: I really envy outgoing people who can chat with anyone.
cards.Hanzi: 我挺羡慕外向的人，跟谁都聊得来。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ tǐng xiànmù wàixiàng de rén, gēn shéi dōu liáo de lái.
cards.Notes: 羡慕 (L15) + 外向 (L12). 羡慕 is friendly envy; 嫉妒 is jealous and bitter.

cards.English: The event got cancelled. It's a pity, but I'm also relieved.
cards.Hanzi: 活动取消了，虽然遗憾，可我也松了一口气。
cards.Pinyin: huódòng qǔxiāo le, suīrán yíhàn, kě wǒ yě sōngle yì kǒu qì.
cards.Notes: 遗憾 (L15) + 松了一口气 (L15) + 取消 (L5). 遗憾 is politer than 可惜.

cards.English: That said, falling apart won't help. You still have to keep going.
cards.Hanzi: 话说回来，崩溃也没用，还得接着干。
cards.Pinyin: huà shuō huílai, bēngkuì yě méi yòng, hái děi jiēzhe gàn.
cards.Notes: 崩溃 (L15) + 话说回来 (L14). 崩溃 is often casual exaggeration: 我快崩溃了.
